definitions.explanation: The punctuation mark (.) used to end a sentence, primarily in Western-language contexts. In Japanese typography, the equivalent is the 句点 (くてん).
Used figuratively to mean putting a definitive end to something, such as a relationship, conflict, or era. Almost always appears in the phrase 終止符を打つ.

examples.english: Put a period at the end of a sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文末|ぶんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ピリオド→ピリオド：12838_piriodo⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In English, a period is used at the end of a sentence.

examples.japanese: {終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check whether the period is in the correct position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: They put an end to the long dispute.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: This ruling brought the case to a close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made up my mind to put an end to our relationship.

notes:
Composed of {終止|しゅうし} (ending, termination) + {符|ふ} (mark, sign).

LITERAL SENSE:
Refers to a period/full stop (.) in Western-language punctuation. The Japanese equivalent is ⟦{句点|くてん}→句点：19157_kuten⟧ (。).

FIGURATIVE SENSE:
Much more commonly used in the figurative sense of "putting a definitive end to something." Almost always appears in the set expression {終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to put an end to; to bring to a close
- {終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}たれる→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to be brought to an end (passive)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to put an end to 〜

USAGE:
- ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to end a dispute
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to end a relationship
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終止符|しゅうしふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to bring an era to a close
